title: Jeffery Simmons' Bears dominate Seahawks 34-17
channel_name: The Athletic Football Show: A show about the NFL
text: There are immediate dividends, and there's what Jeffery Simmons did for the Chicago Bears on Monday night. title: [FULL EPISODE] Bears dominate Seahawks in Seattle, 34-17!
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: The Bears went into Seattle on Monday Night Football and walked away with a dominant 34-17 win! Mark Grote and Leila Rahimi react to what we saw. Defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons showed just how much of a game-wrecker he is, and quarterback Caleb Williams and the offense continuously answered the Seahawks when they needed to. This was quite the statement win.
